subject: Temporary P1/P2 Response Consolidation & Escalation Runbook - Tresor Health
messages:
From: Sasha Bennett <sasha@tresorhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@tresorhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary support consolidation for launch traffic spike

Hi Priya,

Quick note from the ops team at Tresor — we’ve got a feature launch next week that will concentrate traffic to a small set of endpoints. Our SRE lead recommends a short-term change to the P1/P2 on-call routing so we don’t have duplicated handoffs across midnight windows.

Specifically we’re asking Redwood for: 
- A temporary consolidation of P1 response to a single US-based on-call rotation for 72 hours (hours: 00:00-08:00 PDT)
- A documented escalation ladder and a single bridge lead during that window
- Confirmation of expected median P1 response and any risk to latency SLOs

We understand this is an SLA exception and are happy to sign an amendment / limited-time addendum. Can you send a proposed runbook and the names for the rotation?

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Bennett
Head of Platform Ops, Tresor Health

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Bennett <sasha@tresorhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary support consolidation for launch traffic spike

Hi Sasha — thank you for the heads up. We can support a targeted, time-boxed consolidation but need internal approvals and a clear runbook and escalation matrix.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll circulate a draft temporary runbook with proposed on-call names and escalation contacts (attached).
2) Ben (SRE ops) will validate the coverage plan and impact to P1 median response.
3) Naomi (support ops) will confirm rotation logistics and billing/credits for the exception window.
4) Once we have internal sign-off we’ll send a short SLA amendment for countersignature.

I’ve attached an initial draft (tresor_temp_runbook_v1.pdf) and a proposed roster. Please review and mark edits. Ben / Naomi — can you review the health checks and escalation ladder by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tresor_temp_runbook_v1.pdf, oncall_roster_proposal.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Sasha Bennett <sasha@tresorhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary support consolidation for launch traffic spike

Thanks — looked through the draft runbook. Summary of technical validation: 
- Single-rotation approach is feasible for a 72-hour window with the proposed hours (00:00-08:00 PDT).
- Expected median P1 acknowledgment: ~8–12 minutes with continuous paging and a hot standby policy. If traffic exceeds our thresholds we’ll trigger burst capacity fallback to a secondary model variant to preserve latency SLOs.

Edits I made in the runbook (see PDF comments):
- Add a pre-launch warmup check (verify KV cache priming and prefix cache hit rate)
- Include a hard escalation at 30 minutes to the on-call engineering lead and to Priya for customer escalation
- Bridge lead responsibilities and contact card added

Open question for procurement: we need written confirmation on whether Tresor will accept a temporary SLA credit in lieu of expanded headcount for the window (we usually offer a credit formula for exception windows).

Ben Carter
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sasha Bennett <sasha@tresorhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary support consolidation for launch traffic spike

Quick logistics note: the roster spreadsheet includes two volunteers for the overnight window (J. Patel and L. Wright) — I flagged that for backup coverage in case of illness. I also added the escalation phone tree and a short-scope play for a rapid rollback of the client-side feature if backend latency exceeds 900ms p95 for two consecutive 10-minute windows.

On billing: standard practice is a one-time exception fee or a credit calculation. I’ve drafted language for the amendment; Marcus will need to approve the SLA exception and the credit terms.

Naomi Feldman
Support Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sasha Bennett <sasha@tresorhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary support consolidation for launch traffic spike

Approved with conditions — we can proceed with the 72-hour consolidated P1 rotation. Conditions: 
- Agreement signed by Tresor (DocuSign link below) accepting the limited-time amendment including the credit formula on page 2.
- Priya / Naomi to confirm the final on-call names 24 hours before the start window.
- Ben to verify warmup checks and provide a final readiness go/no-go 2 hours before the window.

Sasha — I’ll greenlight this on our side once the DocuSign envelope is returned. Priya, please circulate the final runbook and the signed amendment link so we can track closure.

Marcus Lin
VP, Technical Operations
Redwood Inference

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D
Runbook (final will be uploaded): https://docsend.example.com/tresor-sla-amendment
